messages:
sara_support: FYI — customer (AcmeCorp) hitting 500s + repeated retries from our Python SDK after yesterday's model/catalog update. They see a catastrophic retry loop and billing spike. Stack snippet attached.

sara_support: Repro steps I ran locally:
```bash
pip install redwood-sdk==1.3.0
python repro.py
```
repro.py:```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.generate(prompt="x")
print(resp.status_code, resp.json())
```

sara_support: Error: 500, body: {"error":"internal server error", "detail": "Unexpected enum value: 'foo_bar'"} — customer only started after they pinned SDK v1.3.0. If I bump to local regen (master) SDK it falls back to 200 but client serializes as string vs enum mismatch.

mike_devex: thanks — can you paste full request/response headers? also which OpenAPI version the customer uses (we shipped a small enum expansion yesterday).

sara_support: headers: Authorization, Content-Type: application/json, Redwood-Sdk: python/1.3.0. OpenAPI tag on server: v2026-03-15 (we added tokenizationType enum with value "foo_bar"). Customer uses pinned engine that expects older enum set.

leo_codegen: ping — we regenerated the Python/TS/Go clients with openapi-gen v0.9.4 as part of PR #4127 that added tokenizationType. Did we include a changelog note about enum additions? I think TS and Go surfaced union/enum types differently.

ci-bot: CI: client-regenerate workflow failed on 1987654301-openapi-diff-check — schema diff detected: new enum member tokenizationType: foo_bar — regression threshold exceeded. See: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4127

mike_devex: that CI failure suggests we should have blocked the release. Was the published hosted API rolled forward without a client compatibility bump?

leo_codegen: We merged the server-side OpenAPI change, but the regen CI job ran after the merge and flagged the diff. The maintainer manually approved the publish to hosted before cross-sdk regen completed — bad flow.

olivia_eng: short-term: we can add server-side tolerant parsing to accept unknown enum values as legacy-string fallback and return 200 for compatibility. Long-term: enforce regen CI gates before API deploy.

julie_support: customer reported immediate billing spike from retries — finance needs an ETA on mitigation. Can we fast-path a rollback or client patch?

mike_devex: plan: 1) olivia to deploy tolerant-parsing hotfix to hosted within 1 hour; 2) leo to open an emergency client patch that maps unknown tokenizationType values to a string fallback and ship tiny Python/TS patch (patch-level release 1.3.1); 3) add CI gate to block hosted deploys if client regen diff fails.

leo_codegen: I'll cut a 1.3.1 hotfix with a minimal patch that treats unrecognized enum as raw string. Pushing now.

ci-bot: Release pipeline: client-python/1.3.1 build queued — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/9981

julie_support: I'll message AcmeCorp about temporary mitigation and that we're expediting a hotfix. Also offering to refund the retry-billing window.

sara_support: repro notes for engineering: reproducible with SDK v1.3.0 + server schema v2026-03-15 when request contains tokenizationType: "foo_bar". Works when using regenerated SDK from main (post-regen) or when server accepts unknown enums.

mike_devex: follow-ups: we need a short changelog entry in the regen PR that explicitly calls out enum additions and client breaking surface for pinned SDKs. Also track which customers pin old SDKs to notify proactively.

olivia_eng: deploying tolerant parse now. If anyone sees further 500s after ~5m ping here.

leo_codegen: patched and cut 1.3.1, smoke tests passing. Will follow with TS/Go patches.

ci-bot: client-python/1.3.1 succeeded — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/9981/status

julie_support: customer confirmed errors stopped after ~8 minutes. They've accepted refund offer. Filing postmortem ticket with root cause: OpenAPI enum expansion + manual approval of API deploy before regen CI gate.

mike_devex: thanks everyone. Action items:
- leo: publish TS/Go patches and changelog note (ASAP)
- infra/ci: enforce regen CI as pre-deploy check (OL)
- support: list of pinned SDK customers to target notifications (julie)
- eng: consider server tolerant enum parsing by default for minor enum expansions (olivia)

sara_support: adding repro file and raw logs to the support ticket. Closing loop once postmortem is up. :white_check_mark:
